The IRS defines regular tax for the election as 'the total of Form 1040, 1040-SR, or 1040-NR, line 16, and Schedule 2 (Form 1040), Part I, line 1z, less any tax included on line 16 from Form 4972,' so it omits Schedule 2 line 1z and fails to subtract Form 4972 tax.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: finding; i1116 p. 2 (election to claim the credit without Form 1116): "enter on the foreign tax credit line of your tax return ... the smaller of (a) your total foreign tax, or (b) your regular tax. See the instructions for line 20"; p. 25, Line 20: "Individuals. Enter the total of Form 1040, 1040-SR, or 1040-NR, line 16, and Schedule 2 (Form 1040), Part I, line 1z, less any tax included on line 16 from Form 4972". The English is accurate: ftc.limited is "Smaller of ftc.taxes, f1040.line16". Before Stage 18 the earlier rulings accepted this because every Schedule 2 Part I amount was refused (s2.other then listed "repayment of excess advance premium tax credit") and Form 4972 is refused through scope.other_line16, so line 1z was zero on every computed return. Stage 18 removed that item from s2.other and made line 1a a copy of Form 8962 line 29, so line 1z is now nonzero on every computed return with an excess advance payment, and the limit is understated there. Witness (constructed from stage18.blind.p8, single, a $375.00 repayment and Form 1040 line 16 $0.00, with ftc.taxes $200.00 and the election conditions all yes): project ftc.credit $0.00, Form 1040 line 22 $375.00; by the source the regular tax is $0 + $375 = $375 and the credit $200.00, line 22 $175.00 (refund $167.00 against $367.00). Finding F1 (s3.findings.md), introduced by Stage 18; amount, narrow.

rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope/representation on supported completed individual returns; i1116 (2025) pp.1–2 requires the smaller of foreign tax and regular tax, with p.25 Line20 defining regular tax as Form1040 line16 plus Schedule2 PartI line1z less Form4972 tax, with Form8978 adjustments. s2.other explicitly excludes advance-credit repayments and every other unsupported Schedule2 tax and is enforced at s2.line3/line21. scope.other_line16 excludes Forms4972/8978 and is enforced at f1040.line16. Thus the additional terms are zero on supported completed returns; Form1040 line16 is the regular-tax amount in this slice. Stand-alone excluded cases are not claimed equivalent. The reviewer correctly identifies the full IRS rule; its reduction here depends on those declared refusals, not model noise.
